summary: Clips an input rectangle (a2,a4)-(a3,a5) against a widget's stored 16-bit rectangle at this+0x24..0x2A, then dispatches the result to ShortComputation_16e0. When either widget extent at 0x28 or 0x2A is <= 0 the clipping is skipped and ShortComputation_16e0 is called with the original unclipped bounds. Otherwise the rectangle is clamped: top to min(a2, origin at 0x26), bottom to min(a3, origin 0x26 + extent 0x2A - 1), left to max(a4, origin at 0x24), right to min(a5, origin 0x24 + extent 0x28 - 1), and the clipped rectangle is dispatched.

operations.description: Compute v6 = (this[20] <= 0) testing the first widget extent at offset 0x28, and set v7 = this + 18 (base of the four 16-bit widget rectangle fields at 0x24..0x2A).
If the extent at 0x28 (this[20]) is <= 0, or the extent at 0x2A (v7[3]) is <= 0, skip clipping and dispatch the original unclipped bounds.
Dispatch ShortComputation_16e0(v7, a4, a2, a5 - a4, a3 - a2) with the original unclipped rectangle.
Clamp the top edge: v9 = min(this[19] at 0x26, a2).
Clamp the bottom edge: v10 = min(a3, v7[1] + v7[3] - 1), i.e. origin 0x26 plus extent 0x2A minus 1.
Clamp the left edge: v11 = max(*v7 at 0x24, a4).
Clamp the right edge: v12 = min(a5, v7[2] + *v7 - 1), i.e. origin 0x24 plus extent 0x28 minus 1.
Dispatch ShortComputation_16e0(v7, v11, v9, v12 - v11, v10 - v9) with the clipped rectangle.
Return the result of the ShortComputation_16e0 dispatch on whichever path (clipped or unclipped) was taken.

clean_pseudocode: i16 ClipAndDispatch(this, a2, a3, a4, a5) {
if (this[20] <= 0 || rect[3] <= 0) return ShortComputation_16e0(rect, a4, a2, a5 - a4, a3 - a2);
return ShortComputation_16e0(rect, left, top, right - left, bottom - top);
